query: 2026 primary election dates Florida Arizona Wisconsin governor primary August 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the key takeaway:

**The premise that all three are "August 2026" primaries is incorrect for Arizona.**

| State | Gubernatorial Primary Date |
|-------|---------------------------|
| **Florida** | August 18, 2026 (August ✓) |
| **Wisconsin** | August 11, 2026 (August ✓) |
| **Arizona** | **July 21, 2026** (NOT August) |

The critical finding: **Arizona moved its primary out of August.** On February 6, 2026, Gov. Katie Hobbs signed a bipartisan bill permanently moving Arizona's primary from the first Tuesday in August to the second-to-last Tuesday in July (giving officials more time to meet federal recount deadlines). So Arizona's 2026 primary is July 21, 2026.

All three states share a common general election date of **November 3, 2026**. Florida (DeSantis term-limited) and Wisconsin (Evers not seeking re-election) are open seats, while Arizona's incumbent Gov. Katie Hobbs is seeking re-election. Data was cross-validated across Wikipedia, state/county election offices, Ballotpedia, and news outlets.

key_facts: Florida 2026 gubernatorial primary: Tuesday, August 18, 2026 (closed primary); general election November 3, 2026.
Wisconsin 2026 partisan (gubernatorial) primary: Tuesday, August 11, 2026; general election November 3, 2026.
Arizona 2026 gubernatorial primary: Tuesday, July 21, 2026 — moved from August, so it is NOT an August primary.
Arizona permanently moved its primary from the first Tuesday in August to the second-to-last Tuesday in July via a bipartisan bill signed by Gov. Katie Hobbs on February 6, 2026.
The premise that all three primaries occur in August 2026 is correct only for Florida and Wisconsin; Arizona is July.
All three states hold their general election on the same date: November 3, 2026.
Florida: open seat (Gov. Ron DeSantis term-limited/ineligible for third consecutive term).
Wisconsin: open seat (Gov. Tony Evers declined to seek a third term, announced July 24, 2025).
Arizona: incumbent Democratic Gov. Katie Hobbs running for re-election; first AZ gubernatorial election requiring a lieutenant governor running mate (Prop 131, 2022).
